finding: Changing pilot/search.py together with its v10 receipt after hash passed admission without editing the trusted admission code.
fix: Pin the approved search SHA256 independently in pilot/admission.py, then require the receipt's search after hash to match it. Changing search plus receipt alone is rejected.
trust_boundary: Trusted admission code and exact approved launch revision. This is source drift detection, not protection against an attacker who can replace the admission code itself.
